name: Bard
description: A performer whose art is genuinely magic. Bards talk, sing and improvise their way through problems, lifting allies with inspiration and borrowing whatever spell the moment calls for.
full: Bards make magic out of performance. Their spellcasting is genuinely artistic, drawn from music, oratory and story rather than study or devotion, and it bends toward influence: charm, illusion, healing, and knowing things nobody meant to tell you.

Mechanically they are the best support in the game and a competent everything else. Bardic Inspiration hands allies dice at the moment they matter, Jack of All Trades props up every skill, and Magical Secrets eventually lets a bard borrow whatever spell the party is missing.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You weave magic through music, speech and performance. Charisma is your spellcasting ability, and you know a fixed number of bard spells that you may swap one of on each level up.

features.name: Bardic Inspiration
features.description: As a bonus action, give a creature within 60 feet a d6 it can add to one ability check, attack roll or saving throw within ten minutes. Usable your Charisma modifier times per long rest. The die grows to a d8 at 5th level, a d10 at 10th and a d12 at 15th.

features.name: Jack of All Trades
features.description: Add half your proficiency bonus, rounded down, to any ability check you make that does not already include it.

features.name: Song of Rest
features.description: During a short rest, any ally who spends Hit Dice regains an extra 1d6 hit points. The die grows to a d8 at 9th level, a d10 at 13th and a d12 at 17th.

features.name: Bard College
features.description: Choose the college whose tradition you follow. It grants features at 3rd, 6th and 14th level.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Choose two skill proficiencies and double your proficiency bonus for checks with them. Choose two more at 10th level.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2 or two ability scores by 1. Cannot increase scores above 20. Gained at 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th and 19th level.

features.name: Font of Inspiration
features.description: You regain your expended uses of Bardic Inspiration on a short rest as well as a long one.

features.name: Countercharm
features.description: As an action, start a performance lasting until the end of your next turn. You and any friendly creature within 30 feet that can hear you have advantage on saves against being frightened or charmed.

features.name: Magical Secrets
features.description: Learn two spells from any class's list, of a level you can cast. They count as bard spells for you. Two more come at 14th level and two more at 18th.

features.name: Superior Inspiration
features.description: When you roll initiative with no uses of Bardic Inspiration left, you regain one.
